display_name: Three-way source blind channel agreement diagnostic
description: Evaluate whether two independent interleaved-time coefficient fits agree and improve clean-signal forward prediction on a third held-out time subset.

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Fixed source IQ, independent posterior initial state and three alternative three-step paths
data.tx_sets_ref: No source true identity labels, simulated channel truth, U_s truth, V or test in this validation; clean-F pseudo labels only

permissions.query_use: Fixed previously explored impaired source received and paired clean IQ for oracle diagnosis, ungated blind parent for candidate coefficient fit; no identity truth, U_s truth, V or test.
permissions.claim_scope: Paired clean IQ is diagnostic oracle only; even/odd time samples are correlated, source records previously explored, no deployment or ground accuracy claim.

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only blind action and source Gaussian prior; no DURA, no denoising prior, no F, no model update.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source blind action 94693a342bb2daa684c0f21415d7b949f9fb2107; exact 2048 source cohort SHA c600e6331b6ffef2820e4117b7eef9a946401dc314012a85c06dba73bb209c08.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 2048 source cohort, five complex taps, ridge .1, norm cap .25; three interleaved folds, fixed cosine thresholds .3, .6, .9, each fitted on two folds and assessed on third; no target.

metric_names: per-record held-out clean-forward observation residual before and after unguarded and agreement-gated blind correction
dimensions: RX4/6, RX8 and six simulated impaired source scenes, even/odd cross validation
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Fit two blind coefficient estimates from disjoint time subsets and evaluate their average on third subset. Fit and gate depend only on received IQ and blind-parent forward prediction; paired clean IQ only evaluates diagnostic. The parent uses all time samples and times are correlated.

rows.method: three-fold temporal agreement gated blind channel diagnostic
rows.purpose: test whether fit consistency mitigates signal/channel ambiguity in source only
rows.seed_notes: Prior model seed 2026125054; fixed final epoch8; no source validation training.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Post-hoc source diagnosis after prior simple blind fit increased true-forward residual; fixed source IDs previously explored.
Both coefficient fits and agreement gate use only received IQ and blind-parent forward prediction; paired clean IQ only evaluates error offline.
Input parent uses the entire received waveform, and time folds are correlated; third-fold results are optimistic and not independent.
No DURA architecture, weights, teacher or inference; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or target.
